rows.role_title: Presidente Nacional do Partido dos Trabalhadores
rows.text: The Diretório Nacional, meeting in São Paulo on 18 November 2013, resolved to hold the posse of the new directorates and their executive committees in the period 28 November to 10 December 2013, so that all leaderships elected in PED 2013 would be registered with the electoral courts and active at the start of 2014.
